1. (Currently amended) A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, __wherein the elastomer has a Shore A hardness of 40 or less__.

2. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone __with a Shore A hardness of 40 or less__.

3. (Previously presented) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 or 2, wherein the membrane (10) is injection moulded.

4. (Currently amended) A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure, __and wherein the elastomer has a Shore A hardness of 40 or less__.

5. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 or 4, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), __and wherein the elastomer has a Shore A hardness of 40 or less__.

6. (Cancelled)

10. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa __and a Shore A hardness of 40 or less__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).

11. (Currently amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises silicone __with a Shore A hardness of 40 or less__.

12. (Currently amended) A method comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa and a Shore A hardness of 40 or less; and wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).

13. (Currently amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, 11 or 12, wherein the membrane (10) is formed using injection moulding __and wherein the elastomer has a Shore A hardness of 40 or less__.

14. (Currently amended) A method as claimed in any one of claims 10 to 13, wherein the membrane (10) is formed with a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the method further comprises providing a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane to the coil (8), __and wherein the elastomer has a Shore A hardness of 40 or less__.
